_doc: Intel Officer cron jobs — source of truth. Uses opencli-hotspot-grabber skill with fallback (opencli→Chrome→requests). Do NOT edit via scheduler CLI; edit this file and sync.

jobs.name: Hotspot Grab - Morning Data
jobs.description: Morning raw data collection via PIPELINE v2.0. Runs 15 min before analysis to pre-fetch Zhihu30 + Weibo50 + Baidu30 + HN30 + GitHub25 into tmp/ as JSON.
jobs.payload:
Morning hotspot grab using PIPELINE v2.0:

python skills/opencli-hotspot-grabber/pipeline.py --grab \
  -p zhihu weibo baidu hackernews github \
  -o tmp -q

Expected output: tmp/opencli-hotspots-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.json
Expected count: ~140-165 items (zhihu:30, weibo:50, baidu:30, hn:30, github:25)

Report: Total count and any platform failures.
jobs._notes: Pre-fetch step. 08:15 grab → 08:30 pipeline analyzes. Uses pipeline v2.0.

jobs.name: Intel Morning Hot Topics -> Shared Pool
jobs.description: Morning intel analysis using PIPELINE v2.0. Reads accumulated data, filters AI topics, scores, ranks, and writes shared pool.
jobs.payload:
Morning intel analysis - PIPELINE v2.0:

python skills/opencli-hotspot-grabber/pipeline.py --analyze \
  -i tmp/opencli-hotspots-*.json \
  --output-pool ../workspace-shared/topics/topics-pool-$(date +%Y%m%d)-0830.md \
  --mode morning

Pipeline auto:
- Reads all tmp/opencli-hotspots-*.json (accumulated data)
- Filters AI/tech topics only
- Applies quality scoring (positive/negative rules built-in)
- Ranks by final_score
- Writes P0/P1/P2 sorted topics

Announce: Top 5-10 P0 topics with counts.
jobs._notes: PIPELINE v2.0 - all rules built-in. 08:30 analysis.

jobs.name: Intel Officer Heartbeat
jobs.description: Light heartbeat for intel-officer; report only if action is needed. Checks grab-v2 data freshness, morning/afternoon runs, downstream handoff, shared topic freshness, and delivery state.
jobs.payload: Check intel-officer health: 1) tmp/hotspots-v2-*.json freshness (should exist for today), 2) morning and afternoon hotspot runs completed, 3) the 15:20 downstream handoff to bot2, 4) shared topic file in ../workspace-shared/topics/ exists and is today's, 5) delivery state. If everything is healthy, stay silent; otherwise report only the concrete issue and next action.
jobs._notes: Updated: now also checks grab-v2 data freshness.
